speaker: Elder Hutch U. Fale
title: I Am a Child of God
session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Hutch U. Fale spoke about “I Am a Child of God”.

quotes.text: “All human beings—male and female—are created in the image of God. Each is a beloved spirit son or daughter of heavenly parents, and, as such, each has a divine nature and destiny. …
quotes.speaker: Elder Hutch U. Fale
quotes.talk: I Am a Child of God
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I bear solemn witness of the reality of this “plain and precious” truth, powerful and simple. Understanding our Father’s love and our true identity as His children is essential for our daily and eternal happiness. It prevents deception and gives purpose to this mortal life.
quotes.speaker: Elder Hutch U. Fale
quotes.talk: I Am a Child of God
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The divine pattern of families teaches us of our Father’s love and our relationship to Him. In fact, “our relationship to God … [is] explained in terms of the family.” Holy scriptures also teach us in terms of the family. The New Testament begins with a young family and a baby born in Bethlehem. The Book of Mormon begins with a family’s journey of faith, and the Old Testament teaches how the Creation was not complete until God had organized a family. It is often through families, despite all their imperfections, that our Father teaches us about His love.
quotes.speaker: Elder Hutch U. Fale
quotes.talk: I Am a Child of God
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: First, understanding our Father’s love helps us better understand Jesus Christ. We better understand why He did what He did and why He loves us the way He does. We recognize why He is anxiously engaged in trying to save and bless all of His Father’s children. This understanding makes us eager to quickly and wholeheartedly join Him in His Father’s work. As we are anxiously engaged in this work, we are able to become more like Him.
quotes.speaker: Elder Hutch U. Fale
quotes.talk: I Am a Child of God
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Second, when we understand God’s love for us and for the rest of His children, we become immune to the divisive and misleading labels of our fallen world, both the labels that people try to put on us and the labels the world tries to put on others. We see ourselves and all of God’s children as beloved and divine. We become quick to repent, slow to judge, and ever hopeful that the best is yet before us. We are forever willing to love and to make sure that no one is ever sitting, standing, or walking alone.
quotes.speaker: Elder Hutch U. Fale
quotes.talk: I Am a Child of God
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Third, understanding our Father’s love protects us from the pernicious lie that it is too late for someone to change, too late for someone to turn to Christ, and too late to receive His redeeming grace. From the prodigal son to leaving the 99 sheep to find the one, our Father’s message, through His Son, has always been that there is still yet time if we turn to Christ today.
quotes.speaker: Elder Hutch U. Fale
quotes.talk: I Am a Child of God
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: God’s love is real, and Jesus Christ is evidence of that love. To fulfill His divine responsibility to help His Father’s children, He conquered sin and the grave. While still a mortal, He taught us to pray to “our Father.” Not just His Father, not someone else’s father, but our Father—a loving Heavenly Father who gives better gifts to His children than any other earthly father gives to his. Jesus Christ, through His premortal, mortal, and current ministry, points us to eternal life and personifies our Father’s deep, abiding, and eternal love.
quotes.speaker: Elder Hutch U. Fale
quotes.talk: I Am a Child of God
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Today Christ shows us our Father’s love through priesthood keys held by living prophets and apostles. These priesthood keys allow access to sacred ordinances and covenants that prepare us to return to our Father. Living prophets and apostles stand as witnesses that the resurrected Christ is evidence of the continuing and immeasurable love of our Eternal Father.
quotes.speaker: Elder Hutch U. Fale
quotes.talk: I Am a Child of God
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

scriptures.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
